statement: Hairy ball on a model cortex: on icospheres with 42, 162 and 642 vertices, 100 random smooth functions each, the Banchoff indices of the critical points sum to 2 (the Euler characteristic) every time. Random samples, floating point; a structural fact about sphere-shaped surfaces, not a model of the mind.

Exhaustive over that stated set only; the random fields of hairy.py are tested, not checked.
